The '''Mu-3 Shuttle''' was a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] general purpose [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].

==Characteristics==
Unlike previous [[Mu-class shuttle/Legends|''Mu''-class shuttles]], the third variant was a general purpose shuttle used for when stealth was not a mission requirement. While only requiring two crew to pilot the shuttle, it could carry up to forty [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] or [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] and their equipment. It was armed with twin fire-linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].
